description: An oil painting in dark, moody tones. An elderly man in a flat cap and an elderly woman in a shawl, both in worn clothes, lean over a table and hold out coins from an open red leather chest overflowing with gold and silver coins. Loose coins are scattered on the wooden desk among papers, ink pots and a quill. Through a window at the upper right, a grey battleship with smoke trails sits on dark water. A faint orange glow sits at the far left edge. Papers at the lower right carry small, partly legible printed lines.
